description:
I will help you seek revenge. 
The woman driven to death returns, wearing the mask of vengeance!

My kind friend always whispered sweet words of friendship to me.
But you, who sang me sweet songs, poured poison on my lips. So I swore revenge on you.
If you tried to kill me, I would destroy everything you held dear. 

Lucretia Mor, who was saved by Dane Sangster after nearly being killed by Sabrina, whom she trusted as her close friend, resolves to take revenge on Sabrina, who ruined her family, ruined her reputation, and even stole her fiancé. 

Already a dead criminal, Lucretia, with Dane's help, appears before Sabrina as the mysterious Madame Loiseau d'Or, wearing a golden half-mask...
